texto: # Awesome SoonLab AI Game Prompts A curated collection of AI game prompts, gameplay ideas, creative workflows, and indie game inspiration for [SoonLab](https://www.soonlab.ai/home/). SoonLab is an AI-powered game creation platform where creators can turn simple text prompts into playable browser games in minutes. This repository is designed for: - Indie game developers - AI game creators - Game jam participants - Prompt engineers - Beginner game designers - Creative experimenters Whether you want to build a horror game, RPG, meme game, boss fight, or pixel art platformer, these prompts can help you prototype ideas faster. [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Join%20Us-5865F2?style=flat-square&logo=discord)](https://discord.gg/Ny7B7ewdUu) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) --- ## What is SoonLab? [SoonLab](https://www.soonlab.ai/home/) is a browser-based AI game development platform that allows users to create playable games using natural language prompts. Unlike traditional game engines, SoonLab focuses on: - Fast game prototyping - AI-assisted game design - Beginner-friendly workflows - Instant browser-based gameplay - Creative experimentation No coding experience required. --- ## Getting Started 1. Visit [SoonLab Create](https://www.soonlab.ai/create/) 2. Choose a prompt from this repository 3. Copy the prompt 4. Paste the prompt into SoonLab 5. Generate your game 6. Play, improve, and remix your ideas --- ## Why Use AI Game Prompts? Good prompts help AI game generators create: - Better gameplay structure - More consistent visual themes - Stronger mechanics - Clearer game goals - More creative interactions A detailed prompt usually produces better game results than a short generic idea. --- ## Horror Game Prompts ### Abandoned Hospital Horror ```text Create a first-person survival horror game set inside an abandoned hospital. Add limited flashlight battery, creepy ambient sounds, hidden notes, and random monster encounters. ``` ### Psychological Horror Simulator ```text Create a psychological horror walking simulator where the player explores a seemingly normal suburban house. Strange things happen: doors move, shadows change, and reality breaks down slowly. ``` ### Pixel Zombie Defense ```text Generate a pixel-art zombie defense game with wave-based spawning, upgradeable weapons, and a base that needs protection. Include health system and score tracking. ``` --- ## RPG Game Prompts ### Open World Fantasy RPG ```text Create an open-world fantasy RPG with multiple biomes, NPCs with dialogue trees, quest system, inventory, and character progression. Add random enemy encounters. ``` ### Dungeon Crawler Roguelike ```text Make a dungeon crawler roguelike with procedurally generated floors, loot drops, character classes, and permadeath. Include shops between levels. ``` ### Turn-Based Boss Battle RPG ```text Generate a turn-based RPG boss battle with elemental weakness system, buff/debuff mechanics, and multiple phases. Include animated attack sequences. ``` ### Inventory Management RPG ```text Build an inventory management RPG where the player collects, crafts, and trades fantasy items. Add weight limits, item rarity, and merchant NPC interactions. ``` --- ## Pixel Art Game Prompts ### Retro Platformer ```text Create a retro 8-bit platformer with tight controls, collectible items, moving platforms, and multiple zones. Include a simple save system. ``` ### Classic Pixel RPG ```text Make a classic turn-based RPG battle system with random encounters, magic spells, and experience points. Add animated sprite combat. ``` ### Top-Down Pixel Racing ```text Generate a top-down pixel art racing game with checkpoints, power-ups, and AI opponents. Include lap timing and speed boosts. ``` --- ## Puzzle Game Prompts ### Escape Room Puzzle Game ```text Create an escape room puzzle game with multiple interconnected rooms, hidden objects, combination locks, and logical puzzles. Add a hint system. ``` ### Physics Puzzle Platformer ```text Build a physics-based puzzle platformer where players manipulate gravity, objects, and environment to reach the goal. Include 10+ unique levels. ``` ### Pattern Matching Memory Game ```text Generate a pattern matching memory game with increasing difficulty, combo system, and global leaderboard. Include multiple game modes. ``` --- ## Multiplayer Game Prompts ### Local Multiplayer Arena ```text Create a 2-player local multiplayer battle game with different character classes, power-ups, and arena combat. Add best-of-3 rounds system. ``` ### Multiplayer Maze Chase ```text Generate a multiplayer maze chase game where one player is the hunter and another is the hunted. Include different character abilities. ``` ### Co-op Dungeon Crawler ```text Build a 2-player cooperative dungeon crawler with shared progression, complementary character abilities, and boss battles. Include drop-in multiplayer. ``` --- ## Boss Battle Prompts ### Epic Dragon Boss Fight ```text Create an epic dragon boss fight with multiple attack phases, environmental hazards, and a final weak point to exploit. Add dramatic cutscenes. ``` ### Bullet Hell Arena ```text Generate a bullet hell boss arena with complex attack patterns, invincibility frames, and a survival timer. Add multiple difficulty levels. ``` ### Multi-Phase Boss Encounter ```text Make a multi-phase boss encounter that transforms and changes tactics. Each phase has unique attacks and requires different strategies to defeat. ``` --- ## NPC Dialogue Prompts ### Fantasy Village NPCs ```text Create NPCs in a fantasy village with daily routines, gossip dialogue, and side quests. NPCs should remember player actions and react accordingly. ``` ### Dynamic Merchant NPC ```text Build a merchant NPC with dynamic pricing based on player reputation, rare items, and bargaining mini-game. Include randomized stock. ``` ### Combat Enemy NPCs ```text Generate enemy NPCs that taunt the player during combat with voice lines, change behavior based on player actions, and provide hints about weaknesses. ``` --- ## Game UI Prompts ### Animated Main Menu ```text Create a stylish game main menu with animated background, save/load system, settings, and character selection screen. Include smooth transitions. ``` ### Clean HUD System ```text Build a clean game HUD showing health bar, inventory, minimap, and quest tracker. Should be non-intrusive and visually appealing. ``` ### Advanced Pause Menu ```text Generate a pause menu with resume, restart checkpoint, settings (volume, controls, difficulty), and quit to main menu options. Include quick-save feature. ``` --- ## Tips for Better AI Game Prompts 1. **Be Specific** - Instead of "make a game", describe the exact mechanics: "Create a 2D platformer with wall-jump and dash mechanics" 2. **Set the Mood** - Describe the atmosphere: "Add dark ambient lighting, rain effects, and suspenseful background music" 3. **Define Success Conditions** - Tell the AI what winning looks like: "The player wins by collecting all 5 keys and reaching the exit" 4. **Add Constraints** - Limit the scope: "Use only 3 colors and simple geometric shapes" 5. **Reference Style** - Mention visual inspiration: "Make it look like a PS1-era game with low-poly models and dithered shadows" --- ## Common Prompt Mistakes - **Too Vague**: "Make a cool game" → Be specific about genre, mechanics, and feel - **Too Complex**: Requesting 10 features at once → Focus on core loop first - **Missing Context**: Not describing the player goal → Always define win/lose conditions - **Ignoring Limitations**: Unrealistic expectations → Start simple, iterate later - **No Visual Direction**: Generic description → Reference art styles or existing games --- ## Contributing Contributions welcome! Feel free to submit your own prompts via Pull Request.
